tasks.title: Target repo support for cbd commands
tasks.goal: Allow cbd commands to read/write artifacts under a specified target repo.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given I run `cargo run --manifest-path <kit>/xtask/Cargo.toml -- cbd new-review` inside a target repo, when the command runs, then files are created under .cbd/reviews.
Scenario: Given a repo without .cbd, when running a cbd command, then it returns a clear error or guidance to run cbd init.
tasks.notes: Primary UX is to run commands inside the target repo via cargo run with a manifest path to the kit.

tasks.title: Prompt discovery order
tasks.goal: Resolve prompts using local overrides by default, with `--local-prompts=false` to force canonical prompts from this repo.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given .cbd/prompts exists in the target repo, when loading REQUIREMENTS, then the local prompt is used.
Scenario: Given .cbd/prompts exists in the target repo, when loading CONTRACT with `--local-prompts=false`, then the canonical prompt path is used and the CLI logs that local prompts were disabled.
Scenario: Given no local prompts and a canonical path is discovered, when loading CONTRACT, then the canonical prompt path is used and the CLI logs that `--local-prompts=false` can override.

tasks.title: Init command for target repo .cbd
tasks.goal: Create the .cbd directory structure in a target repo without copying prompts.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given a repo without .cbd, when running cbd init, then required artifact folders are created without scaffolding a review or epic.
Scenario: Given a repo with .cbd, when running cbd init again, then it is idempotent and does not overwrite existing files.
tasks.notes: Init only creates directories; no scaffolding or prompt copying.

tasks.title: Docs and examples for cross-repo reviews
tasks.goal: Document the workflow for applying the kit to other repos, including prompt resolution and threat model reviews.
acceptance_scenarios: Scenario: Given the README instructions, a user can run two commands to init a repo and scaffold a review.
Scenario: Given the README instructions, a user can find how to force canonical prompts with `--local-prompts=false`.
